server.mitigation: Provider configuration is administrator-controlled; untrusted serialized LangChain manifests are not accepted, and task execution remains behind authenticated domain adapters.
Routes are authenticated and body-limited; outbound connector destinations and request signing are validated at dedicated boundaries while upgrades are tested.
File inputs are size-bounded and parsed in controlled storage paths; XML and protobuf critical fixes are pinned while remaining High upgrades are compatibility-tested.

collector.mitigation: Inputs are streamed with byte caps, archives are preflighted for paths/count/expanded size, and each parse runs in an isolated temporary directory inside a non-root read-only container.
Every destination and redirect is DNS-revalidated, private networks are deny-by-default, responses are byte/time bounded, and concurrency is capped.
Collector does not accept serialized LangChain objects; provider execution is configuration-controlled and isolated from destination fetching.

frontend.mitigation: Untrusted markup is sanitized, spreadsheet parsing moved server-side, PDF work is isolated to the reader surface, and CSP/browser security headers constrain execution.
